name: wxo-adk
description: The six official watsonx Orchestrate ADK skills for the whole agent lifecycle (requirements, SOP, build, audit, telemetry, instruction quality) plus IBM's official wxo-agent-architect skill, the ADK and documentation MCP servers, an ADK rule, a /wxo-deploy command and a wxo-builder mode.

safety.warning: The ADK MCP server has no read-only mode: its tools create, import, remove, set connection credentials and chat with agents in the active tenant, and the ADK skills deploy agents and promote them to live.
safety.covered: This pack's rule and the wxo-builder mode require your yes for every write call, import, remove and promotion; deploys go through `/wxo-deploy`, which shows the plan and the environment first. `mcpAccess` in pack.json records the access level of both servers.

watsonx-orchestrate-adk.reason: The ADK MCP server has no read-only mode: 64 tools, including remove_agent, create_tool with model-written code, set_credentials_connection and chat_with_agent, act on the active tenant. The mode uses it to list agents and tools; the wxo-adk rule and the bob-essentials security-defaults rule require the user's yes for every write call, and deploys go through /wxo-deploy. WXO_MCP_WORKING_DIRECTORY is left unset, so tools that read local paths refuse to run.

watsonx-orchestrate-adk-docs.reason: Documentation search: the server exposes two read-only tools over https and needs no credentials.
